name: After recital 4
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 as regards obligations of economic operators concerning battery due diligence policies
part_text: (4a) Consequently, the automotive industry cannot be required to fulfil parallel obligations set out in Regulation (EU) 2019/631 as long as the level-playing field between both technologies and reliable supply or raw material is not ensured. Therefore, the 2035 deadline to achieve an EU fleet-wide target of full electrification referred to in Article 1 of Regulation (EU) 2019/631 should be postponed sine die.
